name: Mashed Potatoes
steps: Peel and cut the potatoes into even chunks.
Cover with cold salted water, bring to a boil, and simmer 15-20 min until tender.
Drain well and let them steam-dry for a minute.
Warm the milk and butter together.
Mash the potatoes, then beat in the warm milk-butter until smooth. Season.
notes: Starchy potatoes (russet/Maris Piper) make fluffier mash. Don't overwork or it turns gluey. Warm milk keeps the mash hot.
